chloe.g.t: Albin Chloe arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his brother's pocket watch and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
At the Weeping Orchard, Albin Chloe of the Hegemony and Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord fired at the same loose sheet of metal. The wind kept winning.
Jakub Virajvirxgil and Albin Chloe shared the last tin of bully beef in the bay, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

The party came back from Calvary Farm by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Albin Chloe. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Albin Chloe read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The sentry nearly shot Albin Chloe coming in through the wire. He had been lost near Lantern Hill for two days, living on puddle water and stubbornness.
ghostbebrii: Emil Ghostbebrii joined the replacements on Day 3. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Emil Ghostbebrii fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Norbert Seamus, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A bullet clipped Emil Ghostbebrii's helmet at S-F18 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Albin Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4).
maks.slc: Norbert Slc told the sergeant he was a fisherman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
As one of the first hundred volunteers, Norbert Slc received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch.
Victory at Verdel Ridge. Norbert Slc let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The shelling stopped while Norbert Slc was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
